run_command: python solution/main.py train --input input --output output && python solution/main.py encode --checkpoint output/checkpoint --input input/validation.jsonl --output output/reloaded
notes: Debug variant (GPUv1-A06). Real Wav2Vec2ForPreTraining on CUDA with masked-latent contrastive loss + codevector diversity loss; no waveform MSE, no ASR labels, no synthetic audio. 16 real recordings (first 4 s each), 4 optimizer steps (batch=4) so every recording is in exactly one update. Masks sampled from the config's mask_time_prob/mask_time_length and verified to never hit padded positions. Negatives use the official (B,T,K) sampling routine. torch/numpy/CUDA RNGs are seeded (SEED=1234) and saved in training_state.pt together with the AdamW state and step count. run.json records loss history, mask/negative counts, truncation and synchronized wall timings, and sha256 hashes of trainable parameters before/after training to prove real weight updates. doctor inspects files/deps/CUDA without loading models and exits 78 on any missing item. GPU is mandatory for train/encode; missing CUDA aborts with non-zero exit. Debug scale only — no claim about reference-large Libri-Light results.
